rule: Every exported name has exactly one canonical home, the subpath whose barrel declares it. A name published from a second subpath is a recorded R4 re-export, not a second home: it is listed here with its home and the signature on that subpath that requires it. check:surface fails any duplicate this file does not record. Foundations B re-derives the /sveltekit closure and re-evaluates every entry below.

layeredBarrels.reason: A dependency-axis pair over one source tree, not two barrels: /delivery is /delivery/data plus the SvelteKit route loaders, and its `export *` is the documented superset. The pair is ONE canonical home, the narrower barrel declaring; the reference gate already dedups it the same way (reference-coverage.mjs `excludeDts`). A /delivery duplicate of a name /delivery/data does not export still fails.
